theorems.name: Submission.dr_cc_pointwise_lip
theorems.statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, x i = 0 ∨ x i = 1) → ψ₀ x = x) → (∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c x y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), m + 2 ≤ J.card → (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → (∀ i ∉ J, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → 0 < s → (∀ i, y i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1) → ψ₀ y = ψ₀ x) → ∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ₀ x') (ψ₀ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x
